I just wanna say a thanksgiving announcement today.

So much thanks to God for introducing and blessing me with the opportunity to go to the ICC girls Bible study and be accepted and loved by them. I’d like to say I had a really great time last night with them and even got prayed over for healing. What a beautiful group of girls to connect with, truly a prayer answered.

Thanksgiving Announcement 7/3/2026:

I was just browsing to shop at Burlington today and as I'm just looking for what I am there for, I put away the merchandise since I could not find anything but instead of leaving I get a very strong feeling from the Holy Spirit like a tug to stay in this specific area so I do. 

A woman starts browsing in that area and I just feel very strongly to just stick close to where she's at and as we are looking through clothes together I start a conversation with her asking her how her day is and what she's up to, I asked her if she believes in Jesus. She says yes. She's a Christian and she says that she's browsing for her sons youth clothing for Sunday service to church. 

I get this opportunity to say that we as a Ministry distribute Bibles and we are actually having youth tonight at identity in Christ Church and she also shared with me her church that is Spanish. So I will be visiting this Sunday at 2:00 p.m. however, this small interaction gave me an opportunity to invite her boys to our youth and I hope to see them tonight where I'll be giving a sermon. 

This is just a Thanksgiving announcement and a reminder to be obedient to the Holy Spirit in everything and be very sensitive to when He calls you to do certain work. I might not know the outcome but I have asked her if she needed any prayers and she politely said that she's good. However, I do understand that there is a reason for everything and I'm grateful beyond a shadow of a doubt that God had a hand and everything for her family. 

For anyone who is interested, here is the church and the service is at 2:00 p.m. Sunday. 

God bless you all today!

Hey y’all do you mind just praying for me. I’ve really not been in the right head space lately and I really want to get back on track with everything, but it’s been really hard and it’s been effecting me and how productive and efficient I am at work, at home, and in ministry. I don’t know how noticeable it is, but I am aware of it and I just want Jesus to pull me out. Thank you all
Absolutely and no, you're doing great sister! I only see you shining like Jesus. Keep it up!

Also pray that my dad would have more understanding and grace, slower to anger, for what I’m feeling and going through, I don’t mean to mess up at all, but I do still, and it makes me feel ashamed and like a terrible person. I just want Jesus to keep reminding me it’s gonna be okay

Prayer Request 7/6/2026:

I'm at Jimmy Johns here in Bellevue and a gentleman named Bryan came up, asking to pray so God helps him make the right decisions and help him also get a job.

He grew up non denominational but wants a good spiritual leader and I recommended Sam Petrov's church for him (Pursuit Kirkland)

So thankful for God and His eternal abounding peace. From the storm comes rest and peace and healing, I’m so grateful for every single person He has placed into my life and how much love I feel from Him every day just because of the blessings I undeservingly already have.

Thank you my loving Holy Jesus 💞

I just decided to put my birthday into the bible and look at the verses, and I literally have found verses for almost every aspect of my life, from how I was raised to how I am now, how I must live, and even some of my struggles. I have found everything. I have found I am made like a destroyer angel, born like one of the uncircumcised to possibly even condemn those who claim to be with God, but aren't, or to be condemned. I am like a son of Ram, one who survived the fall of My father's failing. I am of the Passover, the time when the destroyer passed over the families eldest son, who believed with grace of the blood of the lamb, I am of thoe who struggled with Idolotry and instead cried out to the lord and he answered me. I am of those who didn't initially recieve the truth from birth, the bread and water and went searching for it... my path is straight not to the left or the right, and I am blessed with understanding now. 

I'd say try it, at least for me I found some almost cool easter eggs for myself that hit really hard

Well just got off my bus, and I have news... I met this homeless woman, and I was helping her with her things, and she asked if I was a believer. Then suddenly she starts spitting scripture at me, and her faith is insane, and she was saying something that like when we are bombed by Palestine, thats when the rapture will come. I don't necessarily believe her, but on the off hand, she is some prophet... I am sharing it. It definitely was an experience.

Ignore my previous message, I just remembered the verse about nobody but the father knowing about the return (facepalm, haha) Thank you for the wisdom God of your word so I wouldn't have my faith led astray)
